title: N21 Visor Silver Metallic

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Nolan N21 Visor Silver Metallic delivers breezy open-air freedom for scenic cruising and city exploration. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1306g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~95 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by a glove-friendly Microlock2 (Micrometric Ratchet) retention system for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Urban open face with integrated visor and N-Com communication ready.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open-face design offers unrestricted peripheral vision; silver metallic finish may show fingerprints; requires separate chin strap for secure fit.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nolan N21 Visor Silver Metallic: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Nolan's Open Face lineup, the N21 Visor Silver Metallic brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Nolan N21 Visor Silver Metallic represents Nolan's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nolan N21 Visor Silver Metallic delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
